sections.heading: Fire Damage Restoration FAQs for Plano Homeowners

items.q: How quickly should I call for fire damage restoration in Plano?
items.a: It's best to contact a restoration professional as soon as the property is declared safe by the fire department, since prompt action helps limit additional damage from soot, smoke, and any water used during firefighting.

items.q: Will my homeowner's insurance cover fire damage restoration?
items.a: Coverage depends on your specific policy. We provide detailed documentation of the damage and restoration work to support your claim, but approval and coverage decisions are made by your insurance provider.

items.q: Can all fire-damaged items in my Plano home be restored?
items.a: Many items can be cleaned and restored depending on the material and extent of exposure, but some porous or heavily charred items typically cannot be fully recovered. Our team assesses each item individually during the process.

items.q: Is it safe to re-enter my home after a fire before restoration begins?
items.a: Always follow guidance from fire officials regarding structural safety, electrical hazards, and air quality before re-entering. Our technicians can assess conditions once it's deemed safe to begin work.
